notes: Qemica now tells you when a number should not be trusted. Following a computational chemist's review: a geometry that did not finish optimizing is no longer reported as converged, frequencies are checked against the gradient before anything is called a minimum, and requesting a method the engine cannot fully run (wB97X-D) is refused instead of quietly substituted. Frozen core reaches classical MP2/coupled-cluster and is on by default, matching Gaussian and ORCA. New checks cover anions without diffuse functions, excited states above the ionization threshold, multireference character (T1 diagnostic), electrostatic-only continuum solvation, and quantum phase-estimation resolution. Frequency scaling now uses the factor published for your method and basis. Warnings are prominent and travel with exported reports, and every result records the numerical settings behind it. Universal, signed and notarized macOS build. See the changelog: https://qemica-lab.com/changelog/
